intro: Designed to enrich daily living, the Ember Coffee Table pairs solid mango wood with softly rounded forms. Its warm brown finish and sculptural profile create a sense of calm, quiet elegance.

features.title: Spacious and stylish tabletop
features.text: The Ember tabletop presents a generously proportioned surface designed to accommodate books, decor, and everyday essentials with ease. The expansive tabletop supports both functional use and curated visual appeal.

features.title: Warm brown finish for an inviting ambience
features.text: Finished in a warm brown tone, Ember introduces warmth and comfort into your space. Its natural tone adds visual depth and warmth, creating an inviting focal point in contemporary interiors.

features.title: Meticulously crafted woodwork
features.text: Every detail of this table reflects considered craftsmanship and careful execution. Smooth surfaces, rounded edges, and refined finishing lend the table a composed, polished, and well-resolved character.

features.title: Balanced curved panel base
features.text: A thoughtfully shaped panel base anchors the coffee table with both visual and structural stability. Its curved profile complements the tabletop while reinforcing a cohesive, sculptural design language.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
